information.faq_usdt_title: What is USDT and how do I use it?
information.faq_usdt_body: USDT (Tether) is a stablecoin — a digital dollar. Each USDT is worth exactly $1. It runs on the Binance Smart Chain (BSC) network, which means transactions are fast and cheap (often under $0.10).
information.faq_usdt_bullet_1: Send USDT — Enter a BSC address and the amount in dollars. The app routes it on-chain.
information.faq_usdt_bullet_2: Receive USDT — Select the USDT tab, share your BSC address or generate an invoice. The payer sends USDT from any supported chain.
information.faq_usdt_bullet_3: Swap with rBTC — You can convert between rBTC (Rootstock Bitcoin) and USDT using built-in swap routes (LI.FI or Symbiosis). This lets you pay for services in whichever currency the other person prefers.
information.faq_ownwallet_title: Can I use my own wallet (MetaMask, Ledger)?
information.faq_ownwallet_body: Yes. You can connect your own wallet — MetaMask, WalletConnect, Trezor, or Ledger — from the Connected tab. This lets you:
information.faq_ownwallet_bullet_1: Send payments directly from your connected wallet instead of the built-in BitTasker wallet. When sending, pick your connected wallet as the source.
information.faq_ownwallet_bullet_2: Receive payments to your connected wallet's address. When creating a receive request, select your connected wallet as the destination.
information.faq_ownwallet_bullet_3: See all your balances in one place — the total balance card at the top of the Connected tab shows the combined value across all your wallets.
information.faq_ownwallet_footer: Your wallet stays connected between visits. The app never has access to your private keys — you confirm every transaction in your wallet.
